groups.heading: Cake
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C and line two 22 cm tins.
Combine everything except the bicarb and hot water. Dissolve the bicarb in the water, add and beat well.
Divide between the tins and bake 35 to 45 minutes, turning halfway, until a tester comes out clean.
Rest 10 minutes in the tins, then cool on a rack.

groups.heading: Icing
steps: Sift the icing sugar and cocoa over the butter and beat in the eggs one at a time until it's the right consistency.

tips: The icing uses raw eggs, so use very fresh eggs and skip it for anyone pregnant, elderly or very young.

resolvedChecks.resolution: Raw-egg note moved to a tip.
